program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((blue-cells (find-color g 1))
                  (blue-top (min-of fst blue-cells))
                  (all-cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                        (flatmap (lambda (c)
                                                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                     (if (!= v 0)
                                                         (list (list r c v))
                                                         (list))))
                                                 (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (blank (cellmap g (r c v) 0)))
             (reduce (lambda (grid cell)
                       (let* ((kr (first cell))
                              (kc (second cell))
                              (v (third cell))
                              (color-top (min-of fst (find-color g v)))
                              (shift (- blue-top color-top))
                              (nr (+ kr shift)))
                         (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h)) (set-cell grid nr kc v) grid)))
                     blank
                     all-cells)))))
